I fixed the typo with a new migration instead of editing the old one. In this repo, the files in `migrations/` have already been run in production. If 0007 were edited in place, production would never get the change, and new environments would end up with a different schema than production.

I added `migrations/0008_fix_customers.sql`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE customers RENAME COLUMN emial TO email;
```

`0007_add_customers.sql` is unchanged. I searched the codebase and nothing else refers to `emial`, so no application code needs updating. I haven't run the migration against a database.

The services/notifier migrations are different: they haven't been applied anywhere yet, so editing those in place is fine for now.
